title: Form, engineering and code.
lede: Industrial design, engineering, technology and digital experiences in one profile: Product Design Engineering.
paragraphs: I am in the fourth year of the Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Design and Product Development Engineering at Mondragon Unibertsitatea, finishing in June 2027. Since September 2025 I have been doing dual training at ULMA Handling Systems in Oñati, in the Studies and Proposals department: I model in Revit and produce KeyShot renders and 3ds Max animations for pre-sales.

As a freelancer I design and build websites and applications with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. I am interested in artificial intelligence, robotics, automation, IoT, mobility, sustainability and connected products.
I am looking for specialised internships, graduate programmes and master's degrees in Product Design, Design Engineering and Integrated Product Design.
